questions.question_english: 69. Which committee recommended replacing the existing FRBM fiscal deficit targets with a Fiscal Council and targeting a combined general government debt-to-GDP ratio of 60% (40% central, 20% states)?
questions.explanation_english: The FRBM Review Committee was constituted in 2016 under the chairmanship of former Union Finance Secretary N.K. Singh. The committee recommended replacing rigid annual fiscal deficit targets with debt-to-GDP targets. Specifically, it advocated targeting a combined general government debt ratio of 60 percent of GDP (40 percent for the Central Government and 20 percent for State Governments) and recommended establishing an independent Fiscal Council.

questions.question_english: 39. In the GST Council established under Article 279A, what is the weightage of votes assigned to the Central Government and all State Governments combined, respectively?
options_english: One-third for Center and Two-thirds for States
One-half for Center and One-half for States
Two-thirds for Center and One-third for States
One-fourth for Center and Three-fourths for States
questions.explanation_english: Under Article 279A of the Constitution, the Goods and Services Tax Council operates as a federal decision-making body. Decision voting rules specify that every Council decision requires a three-fourths majority of weighted votes cast by members present. The Central Government holds a voting weightage of one-third of total votes cast, while all State Governments combined hold a voting weightage of two-thirds of total votes cast.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। अनुच्छेद 279A के तहत, वस्तु एवं सेवा कर परिषद एक संघीय निर्णय लेने वाली संस्था के रूप में कार्य करती है। परिषद के निर्णय के लिए तीन-चौथाई बहुमत की आवश्यकता होती है। केंद्रीय सरकार को कुल मतों का एक-तिहाई और सभी राज्य सरकारों को मिलाकर दो-तिहाई मतों का भार दिया गया है।

questions.question_english: 85. In macroeconomic theory, the 'Crowding Out Effect' occurs when:
options_english: Large inflows of foreign direct investment displace domestic state-owned enterprises
Uncontrolled rapid urbanization continuously reduces available agricultural land supply
Excessive government borrowing raises interest rates, reducing private investment
High corporate tax rates lead to widespread tax evasion and informal sector expansion
questions.explanation_english: The Crowding Out Effect is a macroeconomic theory phenomenon where expansionary public fiscal spending funded by high market borrowing reduces private sector investment. When government borrows heavily from domestic capital markets, overall demand for loanable funds rises, pushing interest rates upward. Higher market interest rates increase capital borrowing costs for private companies, subsequently reducing private capital expenditure and business investment activity.

53. What does the term “Jobless Growth” signify
in the context of economic development?
options_english: Overall employment expands rapidly while total national GDP declines sharply
Both aggregate GDP output and total employment fall simultaneously in an economy
Total GDP grows while overall employment creation remains largely stagnant
Total national population drops faster than the overall growth rate of available jobs
questions.explanation_english: Jobless growth describes an economic situation where national real Gross Domestic Product expands continuously while aggregate employment creation fails to grow proportionally. This condition occurs when GDP expansion is predominantly driven by capital-intensive production methods, rapid technological automation, and high-productivity services, rather than labor-intensive manufacturing sectors, resulting in minimal economic opportunities for expanding labor forces despite sustained aggregate macroeconomic growth.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। जॉबलेस ग्रोथ एक आर्थिक स्थिति को दर्शाता है जहाँ राष्ट्रीय वास्तविक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद निरंतर बढ़ता है जबकि कुल रोजगार निर्माण अनुपात में नहीं बढ़ता। यह स्थिति तब होती है जब जीडीपी का विस्तार मुख्य रूप से पूंजी-गहन उत्पादन विधियों, तेज तकनीकी स्वचालन, और उच्च उत्पादकता वाली सेवाओं द्वारा संचालित होता है, न कि श्रम-गहन विनिर्माण क्षेत्रों द्वारा, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप विस्तारित श्रम बल के लिए न्यूनतम आर्थिक अवसर होते हैं, जबकि समग्र मैक्रोइकोनॉमिक विकास निरंतर बना रहता है।

questions.question_english: 86. The graphical representation that illustrates the degree of income inequality in a population by plotting the cumulative percentage of income against the cumulative percentage of population is referred to as:
questions.explanation_english: The Lorenz Curve is a graphical representation used in economics to illustrate personal income or wealth distribution inequality within a population.
